description: This file defines an abstract test case class KernelTestCase for the OrangeHRM system, and is used as a base class for unit tests. It includes methods for creating mock objects, setting up services, and managing dependency injection containers within the test environment.

classes.name: KernelTestCase
classes.description: An abstract base class for unit tests in OrangeHRM, providing service setup and utility methods for testing environment.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Clears the entity manager and recreates the kernel for each test.

methods.name: getHttpRequest
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Request object with specified parameters.

methods.name: createKernel
methods.description: Sets up the testing kernel with services and returns a mock framework instance.

methods.name: createKernelWithMockServices
methods.description: Creates the kernel with additional mocked services provided as arguments.

methods.name: updateOptions
methods.description: Updates the configuration options for the test setup.

methods.name: setHelperServices
methods.description: Sets up mock helper services, such as DateTimeHelperService and I18NHelper.

methods.name: setBaseServices
methods.description: Sets up core services like ProjectService, PerformanceTrackerService, VacancyService, and CandidateService.
